comparison: Five-arm A/B on ARC-AGI-3 ls20: reactive baseline vs EWM text-only vs EWM vision (qwen35b-arc, PRE-fix harness) vs EWM vision (qwen-coding, FIXED probe-first harness) vs EWM graph-native multi-step synthesis (qwen-coding, config.graph_synthesis: ANALYZE->PLAN->EDIT->FINAL state machine, first run on a real game).
harness_note: Arms 1-3 ran on the PRE-fix harness where a program could be adopted vacuously (validated against zero transitions at cold start). Arm 4 runs on the FIXED harness (probe-first seeding: min_probe_transitions=4, adoption requires validate() pass on a NON-EMPTY suite; plus repair caps and a live pass-rate floor 0.5/last-20 -> reactive fallback). Adoption semantics therefore DIFFER between arm 3 and arm 4: arm 3's program_adopted:true was vacuous; arm 4's program_adopted:false means 4 real synthesis attempts each failed validation against observed transitions and the harness correctly refused adoption. Arm 6 (ewm_warmstart_kb_seeded_orient): seeded the 12/13 dev-time ls20 program into the live KB and added ORIENT partial-adoption + live KB wiring; warm start did NOT engage — Run 12's driver predated the kb wiring fix (kb=None, ORIENT never queried), and independently the daemon's 2000-char note cap + 200-char /search summary truncate the program below a compiling round-trip. The seeded program itself is live-valid: 12/13 on Run 12's own transitions, 1.000 changed-cells accuracy, partial-adopts with a 22-cell mask (masked 13/13).

Adoption unchanged: FINAL full-suite validate must pass on a non-empty suite.

A failed session with clean per-change telemetry is a valid result.

ewm_warmstart_kb_seeded_orient.orient_adopted_reason: Two independent breaks, both UPSTREAM of validation. (1) Run 12's driver built the agent with kb=None (pre-fix live_run), so _kb_search('ORIENT') returned [] without any HTTP call — ORIENT never queried the KB at all; modes_visited confirms no ORIENT adoption (RECOVER+SYNTHESIZE only). Fixed on this branch: live_run now wires WriteGate(KbClient(ZONOID_DAEMON_URL, workspace, task_key)). (2) Even with the KB wired, the daemon caps a stored note body at 2000 chars (overlay.js addNoteNode slice(0,2000)) and GET /search returns only a 200-char summary snippet (memory-search.js; full_content=true caps content at 1200 chars), so the 3272-char ls20 program (2010 chars minified) cannot round-trip: the seeded note IS retrieved by the exact ORIENT query 'game ls20 world model program' and passes _is_game_scoped, but its returned body is truncated below a compiling program, so _program_source_from_hit finds no loadable source. NOT the break: retrieval ranking, parsing, live-board mismatch, validation, or the changed-cells floor — the seeded program validates 12/13 on Run 12's OWN live transition suite, scores 1.000 changed-cells accuracy (floor 0.6), masks 22 cells (0.54% of board, cap 15%), and _try_partial_adopt succeeds (masked 13/13). Had retrieval delivered the program bytes, the agent would have adopted it on the live board.

ewm_warmstart_native_note_get_run13.orient_adopted_reason: ORIENT ADOPTED via the NATIVE full-body note read (orient_diagnosis='adopted whole (native)'). This is the Run-13 result of three converging fixes over Run 12's double break: (1) DAEMON: lib/note-source-cluster.js chunkText no longer trims chunk-leading indentation at write time -- it splits the cleaned evidence on the exact '\n\n' separator reassembleNoteBody rejoins with and never trims a segment, so an indented program round-trips byte-exact and compiles (verified live: get_note_full on the reseeded note returns the ceiling program byte-identical to input, python3-compiles). (2) HARNESS native read: kb_protocol.KbClient.get_note_full(key) hits GET /note/get?key&workspace&full=1, the daemon's server-side source-cluster reassembly, and agent._orient now prefers that native path FIRST (index-note key from the ORIENT keyed search -> get_note_full -> extract fenced/marked source -> load/validate/partial-adopt), falling back to the flagged chunk scheme then the legacy inline body. (3) HARNESS artifact-key derivation: the ORIENT keyed /search surfaces the 'knowledge:source_doc:note-<id> ... evidence' CLUSTER ARTIFACT (the index note's own summary is compacted to a stub at write time, so the evidence node outranks it on the program query); /note/get only resolves note: keys, so _hit_key derives the parent note:<id> from the artifact before the read -- otherwise get_note_full 404s (observed live in an intermediate run before this fix landed). Plus a live-KbClient timeout bump (20s->60s) so an ORIENT /search or /note/get under concurrent daemon-drain load does not time out and silently drop the warm-start. RESULT: ORIENT recalled and adopted the 12/13 ceiling program whole, straight from the KB, with synthesis_attempts=0.
ewm_warmstart_native_note_get_run13.why_no_level_cleared: NO level cleared (levels_completed=0, won=false, stop_reason=budget). The warm-start program was adopted WHOLE, but on THIS live ls20 instance it diverged heavily: live_pass_rate=0.05 over suite_size=35, divergences=31. The dev-time ceiling program (12/13 on its own captured transition suite) does not generalize to this game seed's live dynamics, so EXECUTE kept mispredicting and the loop routed to SYNTHESIZE without producing a level solve before the 1500s budget expired (34 actions, no level boundary crossed). The pillar-5 warm-start MECHANISM is now proven end-to-end (native adopt fired); the adopted program's live accuracy is the remaining bottleneck, not retrieval.
ewm_warmstart_native_note_get_run13.delta_vs_run12: Run 12 orient_adopted=false (KB unwired + program truncated below a compiling round-trip). Run 13 orient_adopted=true 'adopted whole (native)': the daemon chunkText indentation fix + native /note/get read + cluster-artifact parent-key derivation make the 3272-byte program round-trip byte-exact and adopt. Warm-start retrieval is SOLVED; the adopted program's live-instance accuracy (0.05 pass rate, 31 divergences) is the remaining bottleneck, and no level cleared before the time budget.

verdict: TRUTHFUL FOUR-ARM FAILED A/B. All four arms completed 0 of 7 ls20 levels. Arm 4 (qwen-coding, both roles, vision on, FIXED probe-first harness) is the first arm where the world-model machinery behaved fully honestly end-to-end: probe seeding banked 4 real transitions before any synthesis, SYNTHESIZE engaged 4 times against a non-empty suite that grew to 80 transitions, and every candidate program failed validate() -- so the harness refused adoption and fell back to reactive play (76 reactive turns), exactly as designed. Contrast with arm 3, where the pre-fix harness adopted a program against zero evidence and then watched it miss all 80 transitions. Net: the fix converted 'confidently wrong world model' into 'no world model, honest fallback' -- same level score, better epistemics. The remaining bottleneck is unchanged and now cleanly isolated: neither local 35B-class model can yet author a Python program that reproduces real ls20 dynamics, whether validated before (arm 4) or after (arm 3) adoption. Telemetry caveats recorded on arm 4: live_pass_rate=1.0 is the vacuous empty-window default (no adopted program to score), and divergences=76 counts reactive turns, not expect-mismatches.
pair_recommendation: For the Kaggle two-local-model pair: use qwen-coding:latest as the SYNTHESIS model and qwen35b-arc:latest as the GAMEPLAY (+vision) model. Rationale, stated with its evidential limits: qwen-coding is the only model observed emitting candidate programs under the fixed harness's real validation gate (4 attempts, parseable fenced programs, no thinking-drain with reasoning_effort:none), making it the better-evidenced synthesis half even though none of its candidates validated yet; qwen35b-arc showed the sharper multimodal grounding in sanity checks (named the exact changed cell+color on the composite, where qwen-coding was off-by-one on a 3x3), making it the better-evidenced gameplay/vision half. CAVEAT: no arm has run qwen35b-arc on the fixed harness, and no arm has cleared a level, so this recommendation ranks failure modes rather than successes; a qwen35b-arc-synthesis arm on the fixed harness would be the decisive missing data point.
